author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Kimi K3 designed a chip in 48 hours.

AI is very good at copy and paste. Let me take a guess, I bet somewhere in its training data, Kimi had read a Github repo of a similar chip. It is just recalling what it has seen from its weights.
